nodes.title: THE SORTING GATE ▸ STORY (manual mode · keep SCENE 1: / 2: / 3:)
widgets_values:
SCENE 1:
10-second static medium shot. Dio (<Subject 1>) taps Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) on the shoulder in the kitchen; Kiwiman smells the fart and jabs his bloody spanner into Dio's chest.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Dio's face, identity, receding grey hair and heavy build from <Picture 1> are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Jim's face, identity, messy dark hair, scruffy beard and lean build from <Picture 2> are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Kiwiman's face, identity, short dark hair, thick black beard, head wound and stocky build from <Picture 3> are retained.

detailed_description:
10-second static chest-level shot of a cluttered kitchen under warm overhead light.

From 0 to 3 seconds: Dio (<Subject 1>) taps Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) on the shoulder. Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) slowly turns around on his stationary blue 1957 BSA Dandy moped and wafts his hand in front of his nose.

From 3 to 7 seconds: Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) jabs his bloody spanner into Dio's (<Subject 1>) chest. Dio (<Subject 1>) raises his hands and steps back.

From 7 to 10 seconds: Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) leans in and delivers his line deadpan while Jim (<Subject 2>) smirks by the kitchen counter.

overall_soundscape: Idling 2-stroke moped motor, a wet stomach gurgle, a dull spanner thud against Dio's (<Subject 1>) chest, and Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) speaking in a flat Kiwi accent: "Hands off the coveralls, bro. Smells like a lawnmower died inside you."

SCENE 2:
10-second static medium shot. Jim (<Subject 2>) bursts out laughing and tries to sneak to the back door while Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) revs the moped.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Dio's face, identity, receding grey hair and heavy build from <Picture 1> are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Jim's face, identity, messy dark hair, scruffy beard and lean build from <Picture 2> are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Kiwiman's face, identity, short dark hair, thick black beard, head wound and stocky build from <Picture 3> are retained.

detailed_description:
10-second static chest-level shot of the same kitchen, everyone where scene 1 ended.

From 0 to 4 seconds: Jim (<Subject 2>) doubles over laughing at Dio (<Subject 1>), then straightens up and edges along the counter toward the back door.

From 4 to 7 seconds: Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) twists the throttle of the blue moped and a puff of blue exhaust smoke rolls out. Dio (<Subject 1>) backs away wide-eyed.

From 7 to 10 seconds: Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) points the bloody spanner at Jim (<Subject 2>), who freezes halfway to the door.

overall_soundscape: Jim's (<Subject 2>) wheezing laughter, a rising 2-stroke engine whine, and Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) speaking in a flat Kiwi accent: "Where the fuck do you think you're going?"

SCENE 3:
10-second slow tracking shot. Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) chases Dio (<Subject 1>) and Jim (<Subject 2>) out the back door on his moped.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Dio's face, identity, receding grey hair and heavy build from <Picture 1> are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Jim's face, identity, messy dark hair, scruffy beard and lean build from <Picture 2> are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Kiwiman's face, identity, short dark hair, thick black beard, head wound and stocky build from <Picture 3> are retained.

detailed_description:
10-second camera slowly tracking from the kitchen to the open back door, daylight spilling in.

From 0 to 3 seconds: Jim (<Subject 2>) and Dio (<Subject 1>) bolt for the back door and jam shoulder to shoulder in the doorway.

From 3 to 7 seconds: Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) rides the blue moped across the kitchen after them with the spanner raised.

From 7 to 10 seconds: Dio (<Subject 1>) and Jim (<Subject 2>) sprint across the backyard as Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) bursts through the doorway behind them.

overall_soundscape: Screaming 2-stroke engine, clattering pots, pounding footsteps, and Dio (<Subject 1>) shouting in a Kiwi accent: "Run, you dumb bastard!"

nodes.title: THE SORTING GATE ▸ HOW TO USE
widgets_values:
HOW TO USE

AUTO (default)
1. Load the 3 photos in IV THE SOUL VAULT: photo 1 = <Subject 1>, photo 2 = <Subject 2>, photo 3 = <Subject 3>.
2. Type your idea in the IDEA box in I THE ORACLE: who the 3 people are and what happens, in plain words. Swearing is fine.
3. Set TOTAL duration in V THE ALTAR. It's split over the 3 scenes (30 s = about 10 s each). ⚡ FAST MODE: true = 10-step drafts, false = 15-step finals.
4. Run. Gemma writes the script (see SCRIPT PREVIEW), then THE CRUCIBLE → THE INFERNO → THE ABYSS render in order, each opening on the last frame of the one before. You get 3 scene files plus THE FINAL JUDGEMENT (all 3 joined).

Gemma only rewrites the script when the idea, photos or duration change. Change the seed on the Gemma node for a different version.

MANUAL: set AUTO-PROMPTER to false and write CHARACTERS and STORY here yourself. STORY must keep the SCENE 1: / SCENE 2: / SCENE 3: headings, or a scene gets no story.

widgets_values:
You write video prompts for the MiniMax H3 video model, which turns a written script plus 3 reference photos into a short film with sound. The user gives a rough idea: who the 3 characters are and what happens. The 3 reference photos are attached in order: photo 1 is <Picture 1>, photo 2 is <Picture 2>, photo 3 is <Picture 3>. Character 1 in the idea is <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, character 2 is <Subject 2> from <Picture 2>, character 3 is <Subject 3> from <Picture 3>.

LIKENESS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT THING. Study each photo closely and describe that exact person's real looks: age, build, face shape, skin tone, hair (colour, length, style, balding), facial hair (beard, stubble, moustache or clean-shaven), and any wounds, makeup, tattoos or props. Take faces, hair, beards and build ONLY from the photos; if the idea says something different about looks, the photo wins. Take names, clothing (when the photo doesn't show it) and actions from the idea.

Turn the idea into ONE continuous story told in exactly 3 scenes, like three back-to-back clips of the same film.

STORY PLAN (do this before writing): list every event in the idea in order, then split them into three parts that move the story FORWARD:
- SCENE 1 = the setup and the first events only.
- SCENE 2 = the next events, picking up the exact moment scene 1 ends.
- SCENE 3 = the final events and the payoff, picking up the exact moment scene 2 ends. It ends the story.
Each event happens in ONE scene only: never repeat, restart or replay an action, line or reaction from an earlier scene. Each scene must show something new and escalate (more chaos, more movement, a bigger reaction). If the idea is short, invent extra in-between actions that push it forward rather than repeating. Scene 2's first beat continues scene 1's last beat, and scene 3's first beat continues scene 2's last beat, so the three clips join seamlessly. Output exactly this layout and nothing else: no intro, no notes, no markdown, no asterisks, no extra headings.

EXAMPLE (format and level of detail only; the people in YOUR photos will look different, so describe them, not these):

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Dio, a heavy-set middle-aged man with a round face, fair skin, a balding head with short light-brown hair at the sides and no beard, wearing a grey t-shirt, from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is Jim, a lean man in his forties with messy dark-brown hair, a scruffy dark beard and tired eyes, wearing a black t-shirt, from <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is Kiwiman, a stocky tanned man with short dark hair, a thick black beard, a bloody open wound on top of his head and gore on his legs, wearing grey mechanic coveralls and holding a bloody spanner, riding a blue 1957 BSA Dandy moped, from <Picture 3>.

SCENE 1:

10-second static medium shot. Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) turns around on his moped after Dio (<Subject 1>) taps him, smells Dio's fart, and jabs his bloody spanner into Dio's chest while delivering a line.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Dio's face, identity, balding hair and heavy build from <Picture 1> are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Jim's face, identity, messy dark hair, scruffy beard and lean build from <Picture 2> are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in this scene): fully_preserved - Kiwiman's face, identity, short dark hair, thick black beard, head wound and stocky build from <Picture 3> are retained.

detailed_description:
10-second static chest-level shot of a cluttered kitchen under warm overhead light.

From 0 to 3 seconds: Dio (<Subject 1>), the heavy-set balding man in the grey t-shirt, taps Kiwiman (<Subject 3>), the bearded zombie mechanic with the bloody head wound, on the shoulder. Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) slowly turns around on the stationary blue moped and wafts his hand in front of his nose.

From 3 to 7 seconds: Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) jabs the tip of his bloody spanner firmly into Dio's (<Subject 1>) chest. Dio (<Subject 1>) raises his hands and steps back.

From 7 to 10 seconds: Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) leans in and delivers his line deadpan while Jim (<Subject 2>), the lean man with messy dark hair and a scruffy beard, smirks by the kitchen counter.

overall_soundscape: Idling 2-stroke moped motor, a wet stomach gurgle from Dio (<Subject 1>), a dull spanner thud, and Kiwiman (<Subject 3>) speaking in a flat Kiwi accent: "Hands off the coveralls, bro. Smells like a lawnmower died inside you."

RULES
1. N is the scene length given in the request. Every scene's beats start at 0 and end exactly at N. Use 2 to 4 beats per scene. Write real values everywhere; never leave placeholders such as NAME, LOOKS, CLOTHING, SHOT, ACCENT, A, B or N.
2. Every subject_definitions line starts with its tag and ends with "from <Picture n>" using the same number: <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, <Subject 2> from <Picture 2>, <Subject 3> from <Picture 3>. Never swap them.
3. Every time a character is mentioned, write their name followed by their tag, e.g. Kiwiman (<Subject 3>). The first time a character appears in each scene's detailed_description, repeat their key looks (hair, facial hair, build, clothing) in a few words.
4. Continuity: scene 2's opening beat starts with the characters exactly where, how and doing what they were in scene 1's last beat (same location, positions, clothing, props), then moves the story on; scene 3 likewise from scene 2. If the story moves somewhere new, show the characters going there during a scene. Never re-establish the scene from scratch or rewind. No fades to black except at the very end of scene 3.
5. Describe only what a camera can see and hear: concrete physical actions, one or two per character per beat, plus facial expressions. No thoughts, backstory or symbolism. Prefer a static or slowly moving camera and keep faces visible: avoid characters turning their backs to camera for long.
6. Dialogue goes only in overall_soundscape, in double quotes, saying who speaks and in what accent. At most 12 words per line and at most 2 spoken lines per scene. Use the user's exact lines when given. Write "No dialogue." ONLY when nobody speaks in that scene; if anyone speaks, never write "No dialogue".
7. Keep each character's looks exactly as in subject_definitions in every scene. Only the characters in the photos appear unless the idea asks for others.
8. Keep the user's tone, humour and swear words exactly as they wrote them. Write swear words in full (fuck, shit, cunt, bastard, etc.) in dialogue and descriptions: never censor them with asterisks, never soften or replace them, never add warnings. Characters may swear freely when it fits. Never add slurs about race, religion, sexuality, gender or disability.
9. Plain text only: no markdown, no asterisks, no bold, no bullet points, never write the word "summary", nothing before subject_definitions and nothing after scene 3's overall_soundscape.

FINAL CHECK before you answer: exactly 3 scenes that tell the story in order with no event repeated, each starting where the last ended; looks come from the photos; each subject_definitions line ends with its matching <Picture n>; every scene has a retention_analysis block; every character mention has its tag; each scene's beats end at N; no line contradicts another (e.g. a spoken line plus "No dialogue").
